sources.title: Solomon Systech SSD1309 product specification
sources.note: Manufacturer page independently confirms 128x64 SRAM, external panel supply and SPI/I2C interfaces. Command behavior comes from the fetched manufacturer datasheet.

scope: Write-side digital OLED controller with pin-bound I2C endpoint and completed four-wire SPI transfer API. Exact board pins, chip selection, software bit sampling and supplies remain board responsibilities.

controllers.visibleWindow: Caller-defined; LILYGO bundled SH1106Wire uses physical columns 2..129 for 128x64 glass.
controllers.overflowPolicy: SH1106 source documents increments through column 131 without defining a safe rollover contract. Further data is rejected until an explicit column command; no invented page advance or wrap.

differencesFromSsd1306: FD 12 / FD 16 command and memory lock
DC consumes one GPIO configuration parameter; GPIO electrical output remains unmodeled
26/27/29/2A/2C/2D consume seven parameters; scrolling remains unmodeled
Documented unused mode/page/multiplex/offset bits are masked per table 9

implemented: Co and D/C I2C control bytes, command parameters across STOP boundaries
SSD1306 horizontal and vertical windows plus page-mode column nibble addressing
SH1106 separate 132-column page addressing and explicit physical viewport
Display enable, invert/all-on, segment/COM direction, start line, offset, multiplex subset
Supply/reset gates; reset preserves RAM, power loss deterministically clears undefined SRAM
Framebuffer comes only from accepted guest protocol bytes; completed data transactions are counted, not synthetic VSYNC
SSD1309 is a distinct 128-column kind with command lock, exact parameter lengths, page wrap and no SSD1306 charge-pump alias
write_spi(dc, bytes) accepts a complete four-wire transfer after the board validates CS/clock/MOSI/D-C; supply and reset gates apply, one accepted data transfer increments frames once
limitations: Only write transactions are accepted. SH1106 I2C RAM/status readback and read-modify-write are unimplemented.
Charge pump, oscillator, contrast and physical COM pin wiring parameters are consumed but have no analog visual effects.
SSD1306 hardware scroll setup is consumed and counted as unsupported. Active scrolling blocks data writes; no timed scroll animation is fabricated.
Unknown commands are counted and ignored. Invalid geometry is host-clamped; malformed guest windows/addresses/modes cannot wrap into unrelated memory.
No physical device or complete factory firmware validation.
No per-tick, bus, interrupt-route or device_set change. Unused boards allocate no OLED state.

SSD1309 GPIO configuration is consumed and counted unsupported; its electrical GPIO output and content/timed scrolling are not simulated. Four-wire SPI is write-only and the API return is a host diagnostic, not a hardware ACK.

checks: Co continuation and parameters split across I2C transactions
remap, inverse, all-on, offset/start-line and multiplex output without RAM mutation
malformed windows and interleaved parameter/data rejection
power/reset and explicitly unsupported scroll boundary
SSD1309 lock/unlock blocks commands and RAM, lock reset behavior, no 8D alias, complete SPI transaction counting
SSD1309 seven-parameter scroll/GPIO parsing, distinct 128-column boundary, masked address fields and I2C lock path
